claims.statement: No secret, token or connection string is committed to this repository, including into gitignored files

enforcement.mechanism: .github/workflows/security.yml runs gitleaks over the history on every push and pull request

verification.mechanism: .gitleaks.toml keeps the default ruleset live for that scan

claims.statement: Dependencies with known high-severity vulnerabilities are visible

enforcement.mechanism: security.yml runs pnpm audit weekly and on pull requests under continue-on-error, so it reports into the log and its check is green whether or not a vulnerability was found; nobody is obliged to read it

verification.mechanism: architecture/security-invariants.md names the mechanism behind each invariant

claims.statement: Lint, typecheck and tests pass on every change, as one command

enforcement.mechanism: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pnpm run quality on every pull request and push to main

verification.mechanism: eslint.config.mjs is the single source of style for that run

claims.statement: pnpm run quality runs lint, typecheck and tests, rather than merely existing as a script

enforcement.mechanism: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pnpm run quality on every pull request, and package.json spells that command out as pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck and pnpm test

verification.mechanism: package.json is the file that command resolves against, so a step dropped from it is visible there
